text:
Olivia H: Quick sync — we need an integration playbook for orchestration tools + gateway partners (LangChain, LlamaIndex, and a couple of gateway vendors). Goal: coordinated doc + joint announcement with AWS Marketplace packaging and NVIDIA hardware validation. Who owns what?

Samir K: I can lead the LangChain adapter compatibility tests. Need a small test harness and a list of model variants to validate (fp16 / int8).

Diego R: For LlamaIndex we should focus on index connectors and pinned model versions. Also need a recommended prefix caching config for long contexts.

Jess L: Can we define a minimal gateway manifest that partners can adopt? Something tiny they can drop into CI to run our smoke tests. :+1:

Matt P: +1 on manifest. Proposed example for the gateway adapter config:
```
gateway:
  name: redwood-gateway
  version: "0.1.0"
  adapters:
    - name: langchain
      config:
        client_timeout_ms: 5000
        streaming: true
    - name: llamaindex
      config:
        default_embedding_model: "open-embedding-1"
        cache_policy: "prefix"
```
Use this for the smoke test harness (curl tests + token/usage sanity).

Olivia H: Nice. Add a short yaml-based checklist for SI partners so they can validate deployment on prem and on AWS Gov. Also include KMS/HSM notes for Private deployments. Jess, can you draft that?

Jess L: I can. Draft checklist items: onboarding, model pinning, quantization matrix, latency SLO tests, KMS integration steps, telemetry export endpoints, rollback hooks. Will post a PR by EOD tomorrow.

Samir K: For the AWS Marketplace/packaging side — we need a timeline: partner engineering signoff -> joint security review -> marketing assets -> publish. Recommend 6 weeks from signoff. Doable?

Diego R: For NVIDIA validation, we'll run perf microbenchmarks on A100 and H100 profiles. Need partners to provide a small inference graph (seq len 1024). I'll prepare the perf harness and perf/latency report template.

Olivia H: Good. Who is the PM for the joint announcement? We should lock messaging early so partner comms teams can review.

Matt P: I can coordinate PM + comms with marketing. Suggest we draft two announcement options: technical spotlight (runtime optimizations + benchmarks) and customer story (early SI integration).

partnerships-bot: Reminder — partnership intake form submitted by @AcmeSI on 2026-07-14 09:12 UTC.

Jess L: Linked checklist PR: https://git.redwood.internal/partnerships/gateway-playbook/pull/12 (will update with KMS steps)

Samir K: Action items: Samir -> LangChain harness (owner), Diego -> NVIDIA perf harness, Jess -> SI checklist PR, Matt -> announcement draft + market packaging plan, Olivia -> overall timeline + partner signoffs.

Olivia H: Let's aim for signoff meeting next Wednesday 15:00 PT. If anyone needs to reassign, ping here. :rocket:
